anonymous_access_enabled.title: Anonymous Access Enabled
anonymous_access_enabled.description: Whether the Git service allows unauthenticated users to browse, clone, or interact with repositories without providing credentials.

network_exposure.title: Network Exposure Level
network_exposure.description: The network scope from which the Git service is reachable, determining the blast radius if anonymous access or permissive visibility is enabled.

mfa_enforced_for_admins.title: MFA Enforced for Admin Accounts
mfa_enforced_for_admins.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for all administrative user accounts on the Git service.

default_credentials_changed.title: Default Admin Credentials Changed
default_credentials_changed.description: Whether the default administrative credentials (e.g., admin/admin, root/root) have been changed from their factory defaults.

admin_password_policy.title: Admin Password Policy Strength
admin_password_policy.description: The enforced password complexity policy for administrative accounts on the Git service.

password_authentication_enabled.title: SSH Password Authentication Enabled
password_authentication_enabled.description: Whether SSH is configured to allow password-based authentication in addition to or instead of public-key authentication.

weak_algorithms_present.title: Weak SSH Algorithms Present
weak_algorithms_present.description: Whether the SSH daemon is configured with deprecated or weak key exchange algorithms, ciphers, or MACs (e.g., diffie-hellman-group1-sha1, arcfour, hmac-md5, 3des-cbc).

host_key_rotation_status.title: SSH Host Key Rotation Status
host_key_rotation_status.description: Whether SSH host keys have been rotated following infrastructure migration or a known compromise event.

https_enforced.title: HTTPS Enforced
https_enforced.description: Whether the Git service is configured to enforce HTTPS for all web and Git-over-HTTP traffic, redirecting or rejecting plaintext HTTP connections.

tls_min_version.title: Minimum TLS Protocol Version
tls_min_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version accepted by the Git service's HTTP interface.

tls_certificate_expired.title: TLS Certificate Expired
tls_certificate_expired.description: Whether the TLS certificate presented by the Git service's HTTP interface is expired or not yet valid.

weak_cipher_suites_enabled.title: Weak TLS Cipher Suites Enabled
weak_cipher_suites_enabled.description: Whether the TLS configuration permits known-weak cipher suites (e.g., RC4, DES, 3DES, EXPORT, NULL, or anonymous cipher suites).

default_repository_visibility.title: Default Repository Visibility
default_repository_visibility.description: The platform-wide default visibility setting applied to newly created repositories.

token_expiry_enforcement.title: Token Expiry Enforcement Policy
token_expiry_enforcement.description: Whether the Git service enforces or requires expiration dates on personal access tokens and deploy tokens.

tokens_without_expiry_exist.title: Tokens Without Expiration Dates Exist
tokens_without_expiry_exist.description: Whether any active personal access tokens or deploy tokens have no expiration date set.

token_scope_restriction_enforced.title: Token Scope Restriction Enforced
token_scope_restriction_enforced.description: Whether the platform enforces minimum-scope policies or prevents issuance of tokens with broad/administrative scopes without approval.

token_audit_logging_enabled.title: Token Issuance Audit Logging Enabled
token_audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether the Git service logs token creation, usage, and revocation events to an auditable log.

push_restrictions_enabled.title: Push Restrictions Enabled
push_restrictions_enabled.description: Whether direct pushes to the default branch are restricted (e.g., only maintainers or no one can push directly without a PR).

required_review_count.title: Required Pull Request Review Count
required_review_count.description: Minimum number of approving reviews required before a pull request can be merged into the default branch. Zero means no review is required.

branch_protection_rule_exists.title: Branch Protection Rule Exists
branch_protection_rule_exists.description: Whether any branch protection rule (ruleset) is configured for the default branch at all. If absent, all other controls are implicitly disabled.

webhook_url_allowlist_enforced.title: Webhook URL Allowlist Enforced
webhook_url_allowlist_enforced.description: Whether the platform enforces an allowlist of permitted webhook target URLs or domains, preventing arbitrary internal addresses from being targeted.

internal_network_requests_blocked.title: Webhook Requests to Internal Network Blocked
internal_network_requests_blocked.description: Whether the platform explicitly blocks webhook HTTP requests targeting private/internal IP ranges (RFC1918, loopback, link-local) at the application or network level.

webhook_creation_permission_scope.title: Webhook Creation Permission Scope
webhook_creation_permission_scope.description: The minimum role or permission level required to create or modify webhooks on a repository or organization.

service_process_user.title: Git Service Process User
service_process_user.description: The OS user account under which the Git service daemon or container process runs (e.g., 'root', 'git', 'gitlab-www').

container_privileged_mode_enabled.title: Container Privileged Mode Enabled
container_privileged_mode_enabled.description: Whether the Git service container is launched with the --privileged flag or equivalent, granting it near-unrestricted access to the host kernel.

run_as_non_root_enforced.title: Run As Non-Root Enforced
run_as_non_root_enforced.description: Whether the deployment configuration explicitly enforces that the Git service must not run as root (e.g., Kubernetes securityContext.runAsNonRoot, Docker USER directive, or systemd service User= directive).

backup_encryption_enabled.title: Backup Encryption Enabled
backup_encryption_enabled.description: Whether backup archives are encrypted at rest (e.g., AES-256, GPG, or storage-provider-managed encryption).

backup_storage_access_policy.title: Backup Storage Access Policy
backup_storage_access_policy.description: The effective access control policy on the backup storage location (object bucket, NFS share, or local directory).

audit_log_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_log_enabled.description: Whether audit logging is enabled on the Git platform instance at the platform level.

audit_log_categories_covered.title: Audit Log Event Categories Covered
audit_log_categories_covered.description: List of event categories actively captured in audit logs. Expected values include: authentication, repository_access, permission_changes, webhook_events, admin_actions.

audit_log_retention_days.title: Audit Log Retention Period (Days)
audit_log_retention_days.description: Number of days audit logs are retained before being purged or rotated without archival. Zero means no retention configured.

version_has_known_cve.title: Running Version Has Known CVEs
version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the currently installed Git platform version has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs that have not been patched.

patch_management_policy_exists.title: Patch Management Policy Exists
patch_management_policy_exists.description: Indicates whether a formal patch management policy or automated update process is in place for the Git platform, ensuring timely application of security patches.

days_since_last_version_update.title: Days Since Last Platform Version Update
days_since_last_version_update.description: Number of days elapsed since the Git platform was last updated to a new release or patch version.

network_binding_scope.title: Network Binding Scope
network_binding_scope.description: Indicates whether the Git service's web interface, SSH port, and API are bound to all interfaces (0.0.0.0/wildcard), a specific internal interface, or localhost only.

network_layer_control_present.title: Network-Layer Access Control Present
network_layer_control_present.description: Whether a network-layer control (firewall rule, VPN requirement, or reverse proxy with IP allowlisting) is confirmed to restrict access to the Git service's ports from untrusted segments.

publicly_resolvable_hostname.title: Service Has Publicly Resolvable Hostname
publicly_resolvable_hostname.description: Whether the Git service is reachable via a publicly resolvable DNS hostname, indicating intentional or accidental exposure to the public internet.

config_secrets_encrypted_at_rest.title: Configuration Secrets Encrypted at Rest
config_secrets_encrypted_at_rest.description: Whether the platform's on-disk configuration files (database credentials, SMTP passwords, LDAP bind passwords, object storage keys) are encrypted at rest rather than stored in plaintext.

secrets_detected_in_repository_commits.title: Secrets Detected in Repository Commits or History
secrets_detected_in_repository_commits.description: Whether a secret-scanning tool has found credentials, API keys, or passwords in current repository content or historical git commits that have not been purged/rewritten.

secret_scanning_enabled.title: Automated Secret Scanning Enabled
secret_scanning_enabled.description: Whether automated secret scanning (pre-receive hooks, CI/CD pipeline scanning, or platform-native secret detection) is enabled to prevent secrets from being committed or to alert on existing secrets.
